body:
incident-bot: PAGED: High GPU queue growth in us-west1 (region us-west1-a). Autoscaler failing to provision; pending pods ~420, average token latency spiking to 1.8s. Severity: SEV2.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Acked. I'm taking pager. Starting runbook -> gpu-capacity-exhaustion.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Quick check: autoscaler error is `quota exceeded` in logs or a placement failure?

Tara N. (eng-runtime): Seeing repeated placement errors: 
```
ERROR allocator: unable to place pod; reason=fragmentation; required_mig_slices=[2,2]; candidate_nodes=0
ERROR autoscaler: scale attempt failed: no eligible nodes, capacity_pool=prod-gpus-usw1
```

Miguel R. (eng-ml): Confirmed. We have a mix of MIG sizes: 1g.5gb, 2g.10gb pinned by older dedicated workloads. Binpacking looks fragmented. Lots of small reserved slices that can't accept new 2g requests.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): TL;DR: autoscaler requests are OK, but scheduler cannot pack due to MIG sizing + fragmentation -> stranded capacity. Need mitigation: 1) release low-priority/ephemeral jobs, 2) temporary model fallback to smaller quantized variant, 3) force repack/rebalance, 4) engage platform for manual carve-out.

Sam K. (eng-platform): On it. Checking allocator metrics and candidate nodes. Trying `repack` job now with dry-run to identify movable slices.

DevOps-Bot: Repack job queued: job_id=rp-4955-01. Estimated runtime 6m.

Jess L. (solutions): Carmen, any customer tickets flagging errors? We should prep a status blurb if >30m impact.

Carmen P. (support): 3 customer reports in the last 10m: higher tail latencies and some 504s for >10 requests in a minute. Customers: beta-ai-app, analytics-saas. Escalated to P1 for beta-ai-app.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Mitigations I'm authorizing now: 
- Evict ephemeral batch jobs in `low-priority` pool (threshold eviction=true)
- Temporarily enable burstpool for prod-gpus-usw1 (burstpool adds 8 gpus)
- Start rolling MIG resize of a set of nodes (2x 2g -> 4x 1g) where safe

Tara N. (eng-runtime): Executing eviction: `kubectl -n infra annotate node ... evict=true` -> currently deleting 58 pods from low-priority pool.

Sam K. (eng-platform): Burstpool activation command: `platformctl pool activate --name=burstpool-usw1 --size=8 --mode=emergency` -> status: queued, awaiting quota check.

DevOps-Bot: Quota check passed. Burstpool provisioning started.

Miguel R. (eng-ml): While repack runs, I'm rolling out a smaller quantized model variant to 20% traffic for the busiest route as fallback. Patch: `model: ggml-2q-small -> route: gen/text`

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Repack job logs (snippet):
```
[00:01] scanning nodes: 240 nodes
[00:02] candidate moves: 72
[00:03] plan: move slices from nodes n-102,n-304 -> consolidate on n-81
[00:05] applying move: 18 slices
```
Plan says ~18 slice moves frees 12x 2g-equivalent slots.

Sam K. (eng-platform): Started MIG resize plan for group `mig-prod-1` -> target: convert 6 nodes 2g->4x1g. Running prechecks.

Tara N. (eng-runtime): Burstpool now attached to prod-gpus-usw1. 8 gpus online. Queue dropped from 420 -> 305 (partial relief).

Carmen P. (support): Customer beta-ai-app - acknowledged. Sent initial note: "We are investigating elevated latencies and are performing mitigation. Next update in 30 minutes."

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Autoscaler attempts resumed after burstpool attach. Getting `placement failures` still but at lower rate.

Miguel R. (eng-ml): Repack finished: freed 14x 2g-equivalent slots. Scheduler started binding ~120 pending pods in bursts.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Good. However some older dedicated workloads have pod-affinity that prevents consolidation. We need manual reassign or contact owners.

Jess L. (solutions): I can help identify owners for pinned workloads. List: analytics-saas-dedicated (owner @paul), legacy-viz (owner @nina). I pinged them.

Sam K. (eng-platform): MIG resize prechecks passed for 4/6 nodes; performing live resize on 4 nodes now (staggered).

Tara N. (eng-runtime): Live resize step 1/4 done. Node n-211 replaced 1x2g -> 2x1g. Scheduler acceptance good.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Customer impact update: currently degraded for ~25% of requests in us-west1 for 20 minutes. No full region outage. ETA for stabilization 30-45m. Carmen will post update.

Carmen P. (support): Posted update to affected customers. Notifying larger customers via email thread with Kathryn.

DevOps-Bot: Autoscaler metric: queue_length=118, avg_token_latency=1.05s, pending_pods=112.

Miguel R. (eng-ml): Rolling additional model fallback from 20% -> 50% for critical route. Should reduce pressure for heavy long-context requests.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Still seeing 12 pods stuck with `PodBinding: no nodes with matching mig-slice`. Those correspond to customers sending large sequence-length requests that require 4g-equivalent slices.

Sam K. (eng-platform): Manual carve-out: created 2 nodes sized 4g for large-context jobs (pool: large-context-emergency). Provisioned 4g nodes = 4. Binding 10 stuck pods.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): After carve-out, stuck pods decreased from 12 -> 1. Great.

Jess L. (solutions): Owners reached for legacy pinned workloads; they agreed to a temporary relaxation of nodeAffinity for 60m. That should allow more consolidation.

Tara N. (eng-runtime): MIG resize finished on 4 nodes. Repack ripple applied. Pending pods now 21. Queue_length 22. avg_token_latency 0.42s.

Carmen P. (support): Customers updated: beta-ai-app reports normalizing latencies for most traffic. No further 504s observed.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Declaring incident moving to mitigation state. Actions taken summary: 
- Burstpool (+8 gpus) activated
- Repack job freed 14x 2g slots
- MIG resize on 4 nodes -> improved binpacking
- Manual carve-out for large-context jobs
- Evicted low-priority batch jobs (58 pods)
- Model fallback rollout to reduce heavy-long-context load

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Next steps / follow-up:
- Postmortem: root cause is fragmentation from mixed MIG footprints + pinned dedicated allocations + autoscaler not considering fragmentation in placement heuristic.
- Short-term: update autoscaler to detect stranded capacity and prefer repack triggers earlier.
- Medium-term: schedule an offline defragmentation window and migration of legacy dedicated to standardized MIG profiles.
- Notify product and customers with RCA within 72h.

Sam K. (eng-platform): Opening retention tickets: `PLT-5983 repack-autotrigger`, `PLT-5984 autoscaler-fragmentation-detection`.

Miguel R. (eng-ml): Add model-level fallback recommendations to Optimize: `recommend fallback for >2k tokens to quantized variants`

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Handing off to Sam for follow-up implementation. I'll remain available for the postmortem. Marking page resolved for oncall.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration: 55m.

Carmen P. (support): Final customer update sent. ETA for RCA: 72 hours.

Sam K. (eng-platform): Thanks team. Filing a short blameless incident note and schedule postmortem meeting.

Alice S. (oncall-sre): Closing thread. If anything regresses, ping #incidents immediately. :wave:
